messages.subject: Follow up
messages.body:
Hi Minal,

Thank you for taking the time to connect with me this week, I'd like to get you moving forward.

Please suggest a few days and times that work well for you to complete our 60-minute Karat interview.

Additionally, I have attached the prep guide for the same. Please let me know if you have any questions

Best,
Corine

messages.subject: Your Karat interview is confirmed
messages.body:
